newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CRUYFF WON'T PRESS SLANDER CHARGES AGAINST NUNEZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CRUYFF WON'T PRESS SLANDER CHARGES AGAINST NUNEZ.

text.p: Former Barcelona coach Johan Cruyff has decided not to press slander charges against club president Jose Luis Nunez, who attacked him in a news conference the day after the Dutchman's dismissal last May.
Nunez alleged Cruyff had favoured his son Jordi ahead of other squad members and forced players back into action when they were injured.
Cruyff and Barcelona are still engaged in a separate legal dispute over wages.
